rateLimit.observed: 65 pages 403'd at concurrency 6 (~1 min IP block); recovered by batched re-crawl at concurrency 1 (8 pages/batch, 40s pause)
rateLimit.guidance: live probes must stay ≤ ~1 navigation / 5s; gate captures one at a time
